message.content:
This is a **login page for "Kozy Care"** (a drycleaning & laundry service). Here's what it contains:

## **Form Elements:**
- **Header:** "Welcome back" with subtitle "Sign in to your Kozy Care account"
- **Email field:** Pre-filled with `e2e-admin-phase32@kozy-test.example`
- **Password field:** Filled with masked characters (dots) and has a visibility toggle (eye icon)
- **Submit button:** Shows "**Signing in...**" (indicating the form is currently processing/submitting)
- **Links:** 
  - "Forgot password?"
  - "Sign up" (for new users)
  - "Back to home"

## **Error Messages:**
**No error messages are visible.** The page appears to be in a **loading/processing state** (the button shows "Signing in..." rather than displaying an error or success message).

## **Additional Info:**
There's an informational note for guest users: *"Booked as a guest? Set a password to track your orders — no sign-up needed."*

The page uses a clean, minimal design with a gold/yellow color scheme matching the Kozy Care branding (gold "K" logo at top).
